description: This file defines API routes for handling payment-related operations in a railway ticket booking system, including creating payments, checking payment status, and confirming payments using FastAPI with SQLAlchemy ORM integrations.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI routing class used to define API endpoints related to payments.

methods.name: PaymentOut create_payment(payload: PaymentCreateRequest, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new payment record and initiates a mock external payment intent.

methods.name: PaymentOut payment_status(payment_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves and possibly updates the status of a specified payment based on mock provider status.

methods.name: PaymentOut confirm_payment(payment_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Confirms a payment with the mock provider and updates the booking status to succeeded.
